arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
echo "LEADS_PREFLIGHT_BEGIN"
target=/opt/telegram-robot-leads
if [ -d "$target" ]; then
  stat -c 'INSTALL_DIR_OWNER=%U GROUP=%G' "$target"
  owner=$(stat -c '%U' "$target")
  if [ -d "$target/.git" ]; then
    sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$target" rev-parse HEAD | sed 's/^/DEPLOYED_GIT_HEAD=/'
    sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$target" status --porcelain=v1 | awk 'END {print "DEPLOYED_WORKTREE_CHANGE_LINES=" NR}'
    sudo -n -u "$owner" git -C "$target" branch --show-current | sed 's/^/DEPLOYED_BRANCH=/'
  else
    echo "DEPLOYED_GIT_DIR=NOT_PRESENT"
  fi
else
  echo "INSTALL_DIR=NOT_FOUND"
fi
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,json,stat,datetime
from pathlib import Path
roots=[Path('/opt'),Path('/home/ubuntu')]
for root in roots:
    if not root.exists():continue
    try: dirs=list(root.iterdir())
    except PermissionError:
        print('ROOT_UNREADABLE',str(root)); continue
    for d in sorted(dirs,key=lambda p:p.name):
        if not d.is_dir() or d.is_symlink():continue
        name=d.name.lower()
        if not any(s in name for s in ('telegram','robot','leads','backup','archive')):continue
        try: st=d.stat()
        except OSError:continue
        print('CANDIDATE_DIR',str(d),'mtime',datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime,datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'owner_uid',st.st_uid)
        for sub in ('data','state','backups','backup','logs','.'):
            p=d if sub=='.' else d/sub
            if not p.is_dir() or p.is_symlink():continue
            try: entries=sorted(p.iterdir(),key=lambda e:e.name)[:80]
            except (OSError,PermissionError):continue
            for f in entries:
                if not f.is_file() or f.is_symlink():continue
                if f.suffix.lower() not in ('.json','.db','.sqlite','.sqlite3','.bak','.old','.zip','.gz','.tar','.csv'):continue
                st=f.stat()
                print('DATA_CANDIDATE',str(f),'bytes',st.st_size,'mtime',datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(st.st_mtime,datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
PY
echo "LEADS_PREFLIGHT_END"
